local HS=game:GetService("HttpService")
local folder=workspace:FindFirstChild("PortScene")
if not folder then return "NO_PORTSCENE" end
local R={}
-- 6) 성능 수치
local parts,shadow,models,meshes=0,0,0,0
for _,d in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
 if d:IsA("BasePart") then parts+=1 if d.CastShadow then shadow+=1 end if d:IsA("MeshPart") then meshes+=1 end
 elseif d:IsA("Model") then models+=1 end
end
R.perf={parts=parts,shadowCasters=shadow,meshParts=meshes,models=models}
-- 3) 땅 구멍 검사: 마을 땅 위에서 아래로 광선
local rp=RaycastParams.new() rp.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include rp.FilterDescendantsInstances={folder}
local holes,total={},0
for x=-280,10,10 do for z=-200,200,10 do total+=1
 local r=workspace:Raycast(Vector3.new(x,60,z),Vector3.new(0,-120,0),rp)
 if not r then holes[#holes+1]=x..","..z end end end
R.holes={checked=total,missing=#holes,sample=table.move(holes,1,math.min(#holes,12),1,{})}
-- 4) 팔레트 규칙: 너무 하얗거나 청록이거나 너무 어두운 부품
local pal={white=0,teal=0,dark=0,visible=0} local bad={}
for _,p in ipairs(folder:GetDescendants()) do
 if p:IsA("BasePart") and p.Transparency<0.9 and p.Name~="Water" then
  pal.visible+=1
  local h,s,v=p.Color:ToHSV()
  local tag
  if v>0.94 and s<0.08 then pal.white+=1 tag="white" elseif h>0.44 and h<0.54 and s>0.35 and v>0.45 then pal.teal+=1 tag="teal" elseif v<0.1 then pal.dark+=1 tag="dark" end
  if tag then local n=(p.Parent and p.Parent:IsA("Model") and p.Parent.Name or p.Name) bad[tag.." "..n]=(bad[tag.." "..n] or 0)+1 end
 end
end
local arr={} for k,v in pairs(bad) do arr[#arr+1]={k,v} end table.sort(arr,function(a,b) return a[2]>b[2] end)
R.palette=pal R.paletteTop=table.move(arr,1,math.min(#arr,15),1,{})
-- 5) 겹침·크기: 모델이 공중에 뜨거나 땅에 박힌 경우
local float,sunk={},{}
for _,m in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
 if m:IsA("Model") then
  local ok,cf,sz=pcall(function() local c,s=m:GetBoundingBox() return c,s end)
  if ok then
   local bottom=cf.Position.Y-sz.Y/2 local top=cf.Position.Y+sz.Y/2
   if bottom>3 and sz.Y<40 and cf.Position.X<20 and not m.Name:find('Detail') then float[#float+1]=m.Name..":y"..math.floor(bottom).."@"..math.floor(cf.Position.X)..","..math.floor(cf.Position.Z) end
   if top<0.4 and sz.X<60 then sunk[#sunk+1]=m.Name end
  end
 end
end
R.floating=table.move(float,1,math.min(#float,15),1,{}) R.sunk=table.move(sunk,1,math.min(#sunk,15),1,{})
return HS:JSONEncode(R)
